A '''salamander''' was a type of [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] common throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Biology and appearance==
Types of salamanders included the [[Jandoonian salamander]]s native to [[Jandoon]], [[Mucous salamander/Legends|mucous salamanders]] native to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], and [[Piluvian salamander-storm]]s, which moved in massed packs. Salamanders also existed on the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].
